# Golden Service Mobile Bar & Catering

> Licensed mobile bar service based in Halifax, Nova Scotia, serving weddings, corporate events, private parties and festivals anywhere in Nova Scotia since 2016. Golden Service supplies the alcohol, the special event liquor licence, Serve Right certified bartenders, mixers, ice, glassware and debit machines, sets the bar up before guests arrive and cleans up after. It is a mobile bar setup brought into your venue, not a trailer or food truck.

## Key facts

- Name: Golden Service Mobile Bar & Catering (short form: Golden Service). Tagline: "The Golden Standard."
- Based in Halifax, Nova Scotia, with no storefront: the bar comes to your venue. Works events anywhere in Nova Scotia. Outside Halifax, one flat travel fee covers the team's travel and accommodations.
- In business since 2016. Runs 100+ events a year.
- Rated 5.0 on Google with 52 five-star reviews.
- $5,000,000 liability insurance. Certificate of insurance available on request.
- Every bartender is Serve Right (responsible beverage service) certified.
- Applies for the special event liquor licence on the client's behalf at no extra charge.
- Supplies all the alcohol. Clients cannot bring their own.
- No minimum guest count. Bar service has a 2-hour minimum. Cash and drink-ticket bars carry a minimum spend at the bar; drink tickets count toward it.
- Quotes are custom and sent by email, usually within a few hours of a request.
- Contact: 902-497-0006, hello@goldenservice.ca, or the quote form at https://goldenservice.ca/#quote

## Good fit for

- Couples looking for a wedding bar or wedding bartenders anywhere in Nova Scotia, including barns, farms, wineries, cottages and venues without their own bar.
- Companies planning holiday parties, client events, launches, conferences or team celebrations, especially in offices, galleries, museums, warehouses or other unlicensed spaces where licensing and liability are a concern.
- Private parties, fundraisers, concerts and festivals that need a licensed bar run for them.
- Anyone who wants one vendor to handle the whole bar: licence, staff, stock, setup and cleanup.

## Bar service options

- Open bar: the host covers every drink for the event at one rate. Signature cocktails can be added.
- Drink tickets: the host covers a set number of drinks per guest, then the bar switches to cash and debit.
- Cash bar: guests buy their own drinks from a full bar menu. Debit machines on site.
- Drinks offered: popular domestic beer, local Nova Scotia brands, wine, spirits, ciders and non-alcoholic options.
- Bar pricing is quoted per event based on guest count, hours and bar style. There is no public price list for bar service.

## Light fare

- Fruit, veggie and cheese trays at $75 each. Each tray serves 15 to 20 guests.
- Trays can be added to bar service or booked on their own.

## Weddings

- Two professional bartenders as standard, more for larger guest lists.
- The bar is set 45 to 60 minutes before guests arrive and cleared at the end of the night.
- Custom signature cocktails are available.
- A non-refundable deposit holds the date. For open bar packages, the balance is due 60 days before the wedding.
- Wedding venues Golden Service has worked at include:
  - Halifax: Saint Mary's Boat Club, Spatz Theatre, The Music Room, One Day Affair, Bella Rose Arts Centre, Hatfield Farm (Hammonds Plains), Canadian Museum of Immigration at Pier 21, Maritime Museum of the Atlantic, Pavilion 22, The Pier, Light House Arts Centre, Halifax Central Library, Halifax Convention Centre, Province House, Garrison Brewing, NSCAD University, Atlantic School of Theology, Art Bar + Projects, St. Andrew's United Church
  - Dartmouth and Cole Harbour: The COVE, Alderney Landing, Christ Church Hall, Sanctuary Arts Centre, Sip Bar + Fare, Cole Harbour Place
  - South Shore: The Farm at South Cove (Lunenburg), Shobac (Upper Kingsburg), Bull Point Estate (Port Mouton), Hubbards Barn & Community Park (Hubbards), The Hill Venue (Bridgewater)
  - Annapolis Valley and Hants: Woodburn Ridge (Aylesford), Blomidon Estate Winery (Canning), Beavercreek Winery (Lawrencetown), Wolfville Farmers' Market (Wolfville), The Barn at Sadie Belle Farm (Bishopville), Churchill House (Hantsport), Windsor Community Centre (Windsor)
  - North Shore: Thinkers Lodge (Pugwash)

## Corporate events

- One invoice with HST included, ready for a purchase order or expense report.
- A deposit holds the date. The balance is invoiced after the event, payable net 15 by EFT or against a PO.
- Year-round corporate events: client events, staff appreciation nights, product launches, conferences and production wrap parties, in offices, venues, shops and yards.
- Holiday party packages (pricing on request):
  - The Office Toast: 20 to 60 guests in the office, 2 hours, drink tickets for every guest, 1 holiday cocktail.
  - The Holiday Social: 50 to 150 guests, 3 to 4 hours, drink tickets then a cash bar, 2 holiday cocktails.
  - The Year-End Gala: 100+ guests, open bar for the full evening, custom menu with a cocktail named for the company and printed menu cards.
- Past clients include Dalhousie University, Grant Thornton, McInnes Cooper, QEII Foundation, Volta, COVE, Maritime Museum of the Atlantic, Halifax Public Libraries, Deloitte, EY, TELUS, NS Power, RBC Centre, Halifax Regional Municipality, The Junos and the TD Halifax Jazz Festival. More than 40 companies and institutions in total.
- For festivals and larger events, Golden Service can also manage full event operations: site plans, permits and staffing.

- [Home](https://goldenservice.ca/): Overview of services, bar styles, reviews, FAQ and the quote form.
- [Weddings](https://goldenservice.ca/weddings/): Wedding bar service, what's included, bar styles, the full list of venues worked, wedding FAQ and a wedding quote form.
- [Corporate events](https://goldenservice.ca/corporate/): Holiday party packages, client list, procurement details (insurance, licensing, invoicing, payment terms) and a corporate quote form.
- [Wedding bar planning guide](https://goldenservice.ca/wedding-bar-guide/): How much alcohol to plan for (1 to 1.5 drinks per guest per hour), open bar vs drink tickets vs cash bar, Nova Scotia special event liquor licensing, what a full-service bar covers, booking timeline and questions to ask a bar company.
- [Nova Scotia liquor licence guide](https://goldenservice.ca/liquor-licence-guide/): When an event needs a Special Occasion Liquor Licence, classes 1 to 3 and their fees ($12.45, $24.95, $62.30 per day), which class fits each bar style, rules (legal alcohol sources, Serve Right servers), outdoor requirements and applying at least 10 days ahead.
- [Get a quote](https://goldenservice.ca/#quote): Quote request form. Most quotes go out within a few hours.
